key_findings: 10/18 fixtures had glossary term detection false negatives that unfairly penalized semantic_fidelity
Glossary terms WERE correctly translated but evaluator failed to detect them in translation
When glossary detection works correctly, semantic_fidelity scores are appropriate (75-80)
Without false negatives, dimension average would be ~78-80 instead of 67.2
dimension_reviews.human_notes: Semantic fidelity is actually strong. The -17.5 delta is largely driven by glossary detection false negatives rather than genuine semantic errors.

key_findings: Automated scores closely match human assessment for literary quality
Slight improvement over P3B (+2.5) consistent with human evaluation
Good sentence variety and literary markers detected appropriately
Dialogue and narrative quality well-preserved
dimension_reviews.human_notes: Literary quality evaluation is reliable and slightly improved over P3B.

key_findings: Automated evaluator flags Traditional Chinese variants as 'simplified chars'
Many flagged chars are legitimate Traditional Chinese variants or regional usage
Penalty overstated by ~8-10 points due to variant sensitivity
Actual Chinese quality is publication-appropriate Traditional Chinese
Punctuation and grammar quality is excellent across fixtures
dimension_reviews.human_notes: The -11.4 delta is largely artifact of variant sensitivity. Actual Chinese quality is high and publication-appropriate.

key_findings: Perfect alignment between automated and human assessment
Character names, pronouns, titles consistently translated across all fixtures
One of M3's strongest dimensions - truly excellent consistency
No material issues detected by human review
dimension_reviews.human_notes: Excellent reliability. Character consistency is genuinely one of M3's strongest capabilities.

key_findings: Excellent cross-chunk and cross-chapter continuity
Temporal markers, anaphora, spatial references properly resolved
Longitudinal fixtures show excellent chapter-to-chapter coherence
Minor delta (-4.0) likely due to stricter automated evaluation
dimension_reviews.human_notes: Context continuity is genuinely excellent. Small delta reflects evaluation stringency, not quality issues.

key_findings: SEVERE evaluator false negative problem: glossary terms correctly translated but not detected
11/18 fixtures show false negatives in glossary detection
Many fixtures show 0% adherence when terms ARE correctly translated
Actual glossary adherence is 85-95% but evaluator reports 0-67%
The +10.9 delta is an artifact of P3B's even worse detection, not genuine improvement
dimension_reviews.human_notes: CRITICAL: Terminology glossary evaluator has SEVERE false negative problem. Scores are unreliable. Actual glossary adherence is 85-95% but automated scores range 0-100% randomly based on detection failures.

key_findings: Excellent structural compliance across all fixtures
Minor penalties for leading/trailing whitespace and single-paragraph format
Proper paragraph structure, punctuation, dialogue formatting
Small delta (-6.7) reflects evaluation stringency on whitespace
dimension_reviews.human_notes: Structural compliance is genuinely excellent. Delta reflects evaluation stringency on minor formatting.

summary.primary_issue: terminology_glossary evaluator has severe false negative problem
summary.secondary_issue: semantic_fidelity penalized by glossary detection failures
